name: INTI IU Open 2016

venue.name: Multi Purpose Hall (MPH)
venue.address: INTI INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY, Jalan BBN 12/1, Bandar Baru Nilai, 71800, Nilai, Negeri Sembilan.
venue.details: Enter the guardhouse (beside bus stop) to campus facilities zone, and turn right to MPH

information:
PARTICIPANTS LIMIT : 130 Person. No Walk-in registeration if online registered participants' limit has reached.

(Registered Online): RM13 for the first event. RM5 for the following event until a maximum of RM 35.
(Walk-in): RM 18 for the first event. RM 5 for the following event until a maximum of RM 35.
(INTI IU Student): Flat rate of RM 10, FREE for INTI IU Board Game Club members.

Please register yourself at 7:45am - 8:30am before entering the hall, late comers will not be entertained.
Please register on your own responsibility and make sure you will attend on the competition day, please inform the organizer with the email in contact information immediately if you wish to cancel your registration.
Other information will be update via our webpage, important information will be send through email.
